title: SWF compile: text field restrict property not emitted
description: Fixed. Added `restrict?: string` to TextDisplayObject in engine/types.ts. In compile.ts, after placing a text field that has both an instanceName and a restrict pattern, a DoAction is emitted with AS2: `_root.<name>.restrict = "<pattern>";`. This mirrors the existing letterSpacing DoAction pattern. DefineEditText has no built-in restrict field in the SWF spec — restrict is a runtime AS2 property. 8 unit tests added to text.test.ts covering: DoAction is emitted, pattern/restrict/name strings are present in body, ActionEnd terminator is present, missing instanceName suppresses emission, empty/undefined restrict suppresses emission.
